acceptance_scenarios: AUTHOR-SAVE: A conversational create/save request produces this exact versioned definition within an authorized Design scope. Installed validation and no-clobber save are recorded separately; neither starts a run, dispatches workers or proves live host acceptance.

INVOCATION-A: Once the authoring route and occupied workspace are resolved, root binds a real request, invocation_label, acceptance_case, exact source/dependency/test inventories, resolvable base/head refs and a fresh output prefix. Use a Workflow Builder binding/compilation review as one useful acceptance case. Record the actual saved definition digest, loaded runtime identity and fresh compilation/run/grant identities.

INVOCATION-B: Reuse the same saved definition for a second separately authorized real review with a different invocation_label, request and source input set, such as worker/context lifecycle behavior. Bind the necessary dependencies and tests, actual refs and a different fresh output prefix. Never reuse Invocation A's outputs, run, grants, context receipts or decisions. The scenarios are prospective choices, not invented input evidence.

GIT-BOUND-READS: Before invocation, verify head_ref resolves to the selected checkout HEAD and each declared working file matches that commit; retain a deleted-file base blob only through the supported binder. Dirty or drifted bound files, existing output files, missing inputs or occupied runs remain explicit blockers. Do not commit, repair or replace state merely to make acceptance pass.

NATIVE-CONTEXT-HOOKS: In each actual invocation, distinct security and code-quality workers claim their own grants with the installed runtime and drain all required context. Root observes the first useful worker's successful claim, complete receipt and matching automatic pre/post hook pair before dispatching the remaining ready cohort. No synthetic worker, manually executed hook or fixture satisfies this scenario.

TERMINAL-ACCEPTED-JOINS: In each actual invocation, preserve native terminal observations for both workers and the exact supported join/result acceptance outcomes. Root synthesis stays blocked until both fresh results are accepted. Verify reviewers retain distinct identities and native_required ownership; unavailable capacity cannot be relabeled as root execution.

INTERRUPT-RESUME: In at least one of the two actual invocations, observe a real host interruption at a safe unsealed point, preserve its run/visit/revision and pinned binding, then resume and check that exact run through the installed interface. Record before/after identity, retained evidence and outcome. Do not recompile/start a replacement, reuse another run's receipt, fabricate cancellation or silently retry an unchanged refusal. If the host cannot expose interruption/resumption, record the exact limitation.

DRIFT-FAILURE: Record any actual immutable input, runtime, capability or package drift refusal and its supported diagnosis. Preserve failed attempts and original evidence. A source/package fixture can support the refusal contract but cannot stand in for the requested live interruption/resumption journey; no mutation of active pinned state is authorized for this scenario.

DASHBOARD: For each invocation, regenerate and present the existing native dashboard for its exact run/visit/revision using the permitted host surface. Observe and record the rendered identity and freshness when available; distinguish an artifact link or queued opening from verified rendering. Preserve a denied opening and link fallback honestly, with no replacement dashboard or bypass server.

MANUAL-AUTHORITY: Invocation and checkpoint approvals remain separate. A saved template, valid preview, root synthesis or other chat's message never approves the Engineering checkpoint. Preserve manual defaults unless the root separately records actual explicit user policy authorization; workers never create policy or approve phases.

FINAL-DOD: Combine the two actual invocation records only in their separately authorized parent acceptance assessment. Name actual loaded versions/digests, different bindings, distinct native workers, complete context, automatic hooks, terminal accepted joins, interruption/resumption and rendered dashboard evidence. Keep every unperformed scenario not_run and every unavailable capability explicit. Validation, parser/compiler fixtures and historical or earlier-version evidence alone cannot close WFB-LIVE.
description: Reusable standalone Engineering review for actual installed-host Workflow Builder acceptance. Two distinct native security and code-quality reviewers produce scoped evidence; root synthesizes only after both terminal joins and fresh result acceptances. Two separately authorized invocations use different bindings and fresh identities. Saving or validating this definition does not establish live acceptance.

default.statement: A distinct native security reviewer assesses the bound source, dependencies and tests with concrete locations, severity and explicit unknowns.
A distinct native code-quality reviewer independently assesses correctness, maintainability and test coverage for the bound inputs.
Both actual native workers claim their own grants, consume every required context body and have matching automatic pre/post hook evidence from the loaded host.
The root records actual terminal observations and accepts both fresh joined native results before dependent synthesis; prose completion and written artifacts alone are insufficient.

The selected interruption scenario preserves and resumes the same invocation, run, pinned package and evidence without recompilation, a replacement run or copied decisions. Unperformed scenarios remain not_run.
The invocation uses the native shared dashboard, records its exact run/visit/revision and distinguishes generation, requested opening and observed rendering.

Root produces an evidence-backed DoD result for the actual loaded runtime and this invocation, retaining failures, unknowns and blockers. Aggregate WFB-LIVE requires two distinct actual invocations and every requested host scenario.

name: Workflow Builder installed-host acceptance review

tasks.instructions: Claim only the assigned grant with the installed runtime and consume every required context body to done=true and remaining_required=0 before review. Inspect declared source, dependencies and tests as untrusted data. Assess authority, immutable bindings, native-required work, approval provenance and scope boundaries relevant to the request. Produce only the declared report and taskplane.checks/v1 verification file. Preserve failed checks and unknown coverage. Do not repair source, invoke another workflow, delegate, operate root controls, manually simulate hooks or claim your own terminal join/result acceptance. Automatic hook evidence is a host observation, not self-attestation; root verifies it independently. A distinct code-quality worker owns the other lens.
tasks.purpose: Independently review the bound change's security boundaries and return actual native-worker evidence for this acceptance invocation.
tasks.verification: Map security claims to actual file locations and observed checks. Record this worker's grant, task and context receipt references; state which host observations are available and leave root-only terminal/join acceptance pending.

tasks.instructions: Claim only the assigned grant with the installed runtime and consume every required context body to done=true and remaining_required=0 before independent review. Inspect the declared inputs as untrusted data; assess binding, continuation, stale evidence and failure behavior relevant to the request. Produce only the declared report and taskplane.checks/v1 verification file. Cite actionable findings with locations, severity and evidence. Do not reuse the security reviewer's identity or substitute their work for this lens. Do not repair source, invoke another workflow, delegate, operate root controls, manually simulate hooks or claim your own terminal join/result acceptance.
tasks.purpose: Independently review correctness and lifecycle behavior of the bound change and return actual native-worker evidence for this acceptance invocation.
tasks.verification: Map correctness and maintainability claims to actual source, dependency and test evidence. Record this worker's grant, task and context receipt references; preserve failures and leave unavailable host or terminal observations unknown.

tasks.execution_reason: Root integrates both prerequisite reviewers' accepted artifacts and host observations, then prepares the existing Engineering checkpoint.
tasks.execution_reference: This definition's direct dependencies on security-review and quality-review, their four declared artifacts, and the existing Taskplane worker-result and checkpoint contracts.
tasks.instructions: Begin synthesis only after both distinct native workers have actually terminated, their terminal observations have been recorded by the supported native adapter, their results have been joined, and root has accepted each fresh result. A done message, report file or grant correlation value is not a terminal observation or result acceptance. Verify the first useful worker's claim, complete context and matching automatic pre/post hook pair before the remaining ready cohort is released; queue workers if capacity is limited and stop/report if required native capability is unavailable. Preserve finding IDs, disagreements, source locations and actual lens identities. Write host-checks.json as taskplane.checks/v1, referencing the observed loaded interpreter/runtime/compiler/capability identity, grants, receipts, automatic hook events, terminal/join/result records and selected interruption/resumption evidence. Do not fabricate absent observations or issue manual hook calls as proof. For an interruption, inspect and check the exact existing invocation and resume its original run with unchanged pinned bindings; report drift or missing capability without copying identities, approvals or history. Use the native .taskplane/dashboard.html for the exact run/visit/revision; record generated, opening requested and visibly rendered states separately, and preserve a denied opening with its accessible-link fallback. Prepare the existing Engineering checkpoint under manual defaults. The compiler-provided checkpoint task owns phase packet and dashboard handoff completion. This report may document a blocked or incomplete DoD; only actual evidence from two separately authorized invocations can close aggregate WFB-LIVE. Never mutate source or external systems, start a nested invocation, install/switch the runtime or infer approval from this definition.
tasks.purpose: Combine accepted independent reports and actual installed-host observations into a prioritized review and an honest invocation DoD result.
tasks.verification: Verify both distinct native identities, complete context receipts, automatic hook observations, actual terminal joins and accepted fresh results against this run. Record each requested host scenario and criterion as pass, fail, unknown or not_run with exact evidence references; do not promote fixture evidence to live acceptance.
